newsitem.title: UK: Novorossiisk crude oil pipelines close for repairs.
newsitem.headline: Novorossiisk crude oil pipelines close for repairs.

text.p: Two pipelines carrying crude oil to Russia's leading export terminal at Novorossiisk on the Black Sea closed as expected early on Tuesday for routine repairs, a shipping source said.
The scheduled maintenance shutdown began at 1000 local on Tuesday. The larger of the two pipelines, with a capacity of about 90,000 tonnes per day, will be shut for 85 hours.
A second smaller pipeline will be shut for about 54 hours, the shipping source said.
Operations at other Black Sea and Baltic oil ports were normal on Tuesday, the source added.
